HP_NS = 'http://www.hancom.co.kr/hwpml/2010/HWPML'

    return f'{{{HP_NS}}}{tag}'

def remove_linesegarray(paragraph):
    for linesegarray in paragraph.findall(hp_tag('linesegarray')):
        paragraph.remove(linesegarray)

def get_text_from_para(paragraph):
    texts = []
    for t_elem in paragraph.iter(hp_tag('t')):
        if t_elem.text:
            texts.append(t_elem.text)
    return ''.join(texts)

def set_text_in_para(paragraph, new_text):
    t_elements = list(paragraph.iter(hp_tag('t')))
    if t_elements:
        t_elements[0].text = new_text
        for t_elem in t_elements[1:]:
            t_elem.text = ''

def replace_text_in_para(paragraph, old_text, new_text):
    full_text = get_text_from_para(paragraph)
    if old_text in full_text:
        new_full_text = full_text.replace(old_text, new_text)
        set_text_in_para(paragraph, new_full_text)
        return True
    return False

def find_paras_containing(root, text):
    results = []
    for para in root.iter(hp_tag('p')):
        para_text = get_text_from_para(para)
        if text in para_text:
            results.append(para)
    return results
